mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 2pp but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year and consumer sentiment (UMCSENT) is above its 12-month average, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 10% and UMCSENT > 12mo avg, but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month and payroll employment (PAYEMS) also declines month-over-month, it signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp m-o-m and PAYEMS declines m-o-m, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that the Fed is behind the curve on, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) declines quarter-over-quarter and the S&P 500 is already down more than 10% from its 52-week high, it signals a recessionary environment that will drive further negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Q-o-q GDPC1 decline and SPX > 10% off 52w high, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances.
